wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps 1,500 Points, Oil Slides After Democrats Sweep Congress
wsjHeadlines.description: Crude drops 8% on hopes of Iran war ending; Nasdaq, S&P 500 also rally

wsjHeadlines.title: Index Funds Are Better When They’re Lucky and Smart
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, markets digest the blue tsunami

wsjHeadlines.title: How Beer Companies Stole Happy Hour From Liquor Brands
wsjHeadlines.description: Diageo and Pernod Ricard have missed the cocktails-in-a-can craze, and investors are paying the price.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bitcoin Miners Pivoted to AI—Only to Find It’s Just as Turbulent as Crypto
wsjHeadlines.description: Operating AI data centers isn’t any easier for companies that swapped out their bitcoin-mining servers for greener pastures.

wsjHeadlines.title: Apple Shares Slip, Meta Debt Costs Rise
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Apollo swings to a loss and investors eye midterm election races

wsjHeadlines.title: Want to Try Alternative Investments? Here’s an Easy Way to Start
wsjHeadlines.description: These publicly traded investments offer diversification, but take some time to understand the risks and rewards before jumping in.

wsjHeadlines.title: Mark Walter in Talks to Sell Cadillac F1 Stake to Red Sox, Liverpool Owners
wsjHeadlines.description: John Henry’s Fenway Sports Group is one of the bidders for the outfit at a valuation believed to be above $3 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Apple Is an AI Safe Haven—but Safety Isn’t Cheap
wsjHeadlines.description: Apple is the rare big tech play that hasn’t become a giant bet on the AI boom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Netflix Needs You to Watch, Not Just Pay
wsjHeadlines.description: The streamer’s ad ambitions depend on viewing hours, which have stalled.

wsjHeadlines.title: Investors Are Betting a Blue Wave Will Help Hospitals. Don’t Count on It.
wsjHeadlines.description: Markets are anticipating a reversal of Trump’s Medicaid cuts. That may be easier said than done.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Market Isn’t Buying Skydance’s Balance-Sheet Math
wsjHeadlines.description: The media conglomerate’s goodwill alone exceeds its stock-market value.

wsjHeadlines.title: Alphabet Still Has the Ingredients to Win in an AI Pullback
wsjHeadlines.description: The tech giant is no longer loved by investors, despite its many advantages.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on U.K. bank stocks, AIB Group and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: BOE Expected to Join Peers in Raising Key Rate
wsjHeadlines.description: The bank  is expected to join its peers in raising borrowing costs Thursday, with the Fed, ECB and BoJ having each raised rates at least once since start of U.S.-Iran war.

wsjHeadlines.title: NatWest Shares Fall After Bank’s Interest Income Guidance Disappoints
wsjHeadlines.description: The British high-street bank’s shares dropped after it forecast weaker-than-expected interest income next year.

wsjHeadlines.title: ING Launches Buyback But Flags Job Cuts and Unit Restructuring
wsjHeadlines.description: The Dutch bank launched a new buyback program of $1.84 billion and set out plans to restructure its wholesale banking unit.

wsjHeadlines.title: Societe Generale Posts Profit, Revenue Increase in Third Quarter
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender reported third-quarter net profit that beat market expectations despite a volatile macroeconomic backdrop in its home country.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on motor-vehicle sales in Canada, Uber, BMW and more in the latest Market Talks covering Auto and Transport.

wsjHeadlines.title: Energy & Utilities Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on AI infrastructure, crude futures, natural gas and more in the latest Market Talks covering Energy and Utilities.

wsjHeadlines.title: Health Care Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Switzerland’s pharmaceutical industry, Novo Nordisk, Roche Holding and more in the latest Market Talks covering Health Care.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Jump After Democrats Sweep Congress
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks are surging as investors react to a blue wave that puts Democrats in control of both chambers of Congress.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on AI and the U.S. midterm elections, the New York Times Company, Uber and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Winners and Losers on Wall Street From the Election Earthquake
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stock indexes opened higher on hope that legislative gridlock will keep the focus on corporate results. But data-center plans key to the AI build-out took a hit.

wsjHeadlines.title: Apple Can be an Expensive AI Safe Haven
wsjHeadlines.description: Some of the best analysis and insight on investing, the wealth-management business and more.

wsjHeadlines.title: Democrats’ Victory to Add Volatility to AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: The Stoxx Europe 600 rose. UBS said the strong Democratic performance in midterms would bring renewed volatility to tech stocks, but wouldn’t necessarily derail the AI investment cycle.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asia Markets Get Midterm Whiplash as Selloff Gives Way to Relief Rally
wsjHeadlines.description: Asian markets did an about-face in the afternoon, with the initial selloff sparked by the U.S. midterm elections giving way to a relief rally.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed Amid Midterm, Iran War Nerves
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks finished mixed with trepidation ahead of the midterm election results and skepticism about a near-term resolution to the Iran conflict.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Elon Musk Will Turn Kids Into Capitalists
wsjHeadlines.description: Bank Hapoalim gave shares to customers, many of whom had never invested before.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Ethics Rules Behind Weil Gotshal’s ‘Partner Run’
wsjHeadlines.description: Bans on outside ownership and noncompete agreements make it hard for law firms to innovate—and sometimes even to survive.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Sports Bet by Any Other Name Is Still a Bet
wsjHeadlines.description: The CFTC has neither the competency nor statutory authority to regulate gambling.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | An AI Halloween Market Scare
wsjHeadlines.description: Crypto isn’t risk-free after all, as thieves take Binance for $6.3 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Anthropic’s IPO Will Be a National-Security Win for Taiwan
wsjHeadlines.description: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America’s top foreign policy interests.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | How Do Investors Measure ‘Social Impact’?
wsjHeadlines.description: Developing a common standard would be one of the best ways of expanding economic opportunity.

wsjHeadlines.title: Precious Metals Rebound as Oil Prices Sink Post-Midterms
wsjHeadlines.description: Precious metals futures rebounded after the Democrats gained control of the U.S. Congress, sending oil prices lower.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold prices, palm oil prices, copper demand and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Price Falls Further After Vance Blames GOP Losses on Iran War
wsjHeadlines.description: Crude oil extended losses—with prices down more than 8%—after Vice President JD Vance blamed Republican losses on the Middle East war.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles Post Fifth Straight Weekly Drop
wsjHeadlines.description: Commercial crude oil stocks fell by 865,000 barrels, while distillate stocks fell to their lowest level in more than two decades, the EIA said.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Gas Market Braces for Trump’s Next Move on Iran After Midterms
wsjHeadlines.description: European natural-gas prices fell, reversing earlier gains, as traders waited to see whether Trump will pursue diplomacy with Iran or launch renewed strikes.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Falls After Democrats’ Victory in U.S. Midterms
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar fell to a one-month low against a basket of currencies after the Democratic sweep of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.23% to 97.22
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index rose 0.2%, snapping a four-trading-day losing streak.
